title: Art Tatum, Earl Hines and piano influences
summary: She names Art Tatum, whom she knew in Los Angeles, as one of the greatest jazz pianists, alongside Hines.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Uh-huh. Was there anybody else that was a strong influence that impressed you in piano?
Well, there were several people who
impressed me, as I say. Now, I was greatly impressed by Tatum. However, I just think he was one of the greatest jazz pianists that ever lived, just ever lived, you know.
I knew Tatum personally, and I know Hines too, but I was around Tatum more than I was around Hines.
